content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing a similar issue. I would like to access year, month, day, hour, minute, and seconds within my program. I read these values are available in VM area 985 - 990, but it seems these cannot be accessed directly from the [product_name] device. Is there any alternative method to retrieve the date and time components directly from the device? Thank you for any guidance.
Welcome to the forum. Direct access to date or time functions in a [product_name] program is not possible. Could you please provide more details about your intended application?

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are looking for ways to access detailed date and time elements such as year, month, day, hour, minute, and second directly from their [product_name] device. The responses make clear that this capability is not currently supported or readily available, exposing limitations in the product's handling of real-time clock data and leading to user frustration when time-based logic is required.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect their [product_name] device to offer straightforward or built-in functions to easily retrieve individual date and time values for use in automation programs.
